label: Energy Optimizer Guarded Actuator (Production v2)
info: Production v2 guarded actuator. Every disarmed or rejected state actively cancels forced modes. Discharge translates a semantically validated site-export target (conservatively bounded at 100 kW) from live PV/load and immediately applies the battery balance clamped to the verified 28 kW limit, disables PV charging while exporting, and confirms SAJ feedback after actuation. Grid charge immediately applies its full clamped target up to 30 kW. Live battery SOC, PV and load measurements must have a last_reported (preferred) or last_updated timestamp no older than 330 seconds; static limits and helpers are not aged. Every allow or curtail decision directly reasserts the raw SAJ export-limit register before synchronizing the helper, so an unchanged optimistic helper cannot suppress the hardware write. Each accepted plan also replaces a one-shot valid-until timer that safe-stops exactly at expiry; the independent 60-second stale-plan watchdog remains. The disabled v1 tab is retained for rollback.
